newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand light.
Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers and 700 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 10,200 head confirmed, including 7,700 head or about 75 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3
Slaughter heifers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3
Wk to date - 10,200 week ago - 46,900 year ago - 68,300
